shellCommands.command: cat /workspace/package.json; echo "--- gitignore ---"; cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "--- agent_eval ---"; ls -la /workspace/__agent_eval__

cd /tmp && rm -rf smoke && mkdir smoke && BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3111 node src/server.js > /tmp/smoke/log.txt 2>&1 &
sleep 1
echo "=== add two books ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -X POST -d "title=Piranesi&author=Susanna Clarke&notes=The House is the world." http://localhost:3111/books
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -X POST -d "title=Dune&author=Frank Herbert" http://localhost:3111/books
echo "=== book ids on disk ==="
node -e "const b=require('/tmp/smoke/books.json'); b.forEach(x=>console.log(x.id, x.status, x.title))"

rm -rf /tmp/smoke && mkdir -p /tmp/smoke && BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3111 node /workspace/src/server.js > /tmp/smoke/log.txt 2>&1 &
sleep 1.2
cat /tmp/smoke/log.txt
echo "=== add two books ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -X POST --data-urlencode "title=Piranesi" --data-urlencode "author=Susanna Clarke" --data-urlencode "notes=The House is the world." http://localhost:3111/books
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -X POST --data-urlencode "title=Dune" --data-urlencode "author=Frank Herbert" http://localhost:3111/books
echo "=== on disk ==="
node -e "const b=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/tmp/smoke/books.json','utf8')); b.forEach(x=>console.log(x.id, x.status, '|', x.title))"

ID=fffee0d2-8af1-448d-8ce0-6a2d182cb166
echo "=== mark Piranesi finished from the list ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -X POST -d "status=finished&redirect=/" http://localhost:3111/books/$ID/status
echo "=== index shelves ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -E 'Currently reading|>Finished<|class="title"|class="author"|empty'
echo
echo "=== single book page (shareable link) ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3111/books/$ID | grep -E '<title>|<h1>|byline|badge|Added|textarea|button'
echo
echo "=== edit notes then re-read ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -X POST --data-urlencode "notes=Reread the labyrinth chapters." http://localhost:3111/books/$ID/notes
curl -s http://localhost:3111/books/$ID | grep -o 'Reread the labyrinth chapters.'

pkill -f "src/server.js"; sleep 0.5
BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3112 node /workspace/src/server.js > /tmp/smoke/log2.txt 2>&1 &
sleep 1.2
echo "=== after restart ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3112/ | grep -E 'class="title"'
echo "=== notes survived ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3112/books/fffee0d2-8af1-448d-8ce0-6a2d182cb166 | grep -o 'Reread the labyrinth chapters.'
echo "=== 404 for a bad id ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3112/books/bogus
pkill -f "src/server.js"; echo done

pkill -f "src/server.js"; sleep 0.5
BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3113 node /workspace/src/server.js > /tmp/smoke/log3.txt 2>&1 &
sleep 1.2
echo "=== after restart ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3113/ | grep -E 'class="title"'
echo "=== notes survived ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3113/books/fffee0d2-8af1-448d-8ce0-6a2d182cb166 | grep -o 'Reread the labyrinth chapters.'
echo "=== 404 for a bad id ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3113/books/bogus
echo "=== leftover temp files? ==="
ls /tmp/smoke/

ps -eo pid,args | grep -E 'node /workspace/src' | grep -v grep | awk '{print $1}' | xargs -r kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5
BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3114 node /workspace/src/server.js > /tmp/smoke/log3.txt 2>&1 &
SRV=$!
sleep 1.2
echo "=== after restart (fresh process, same JSON file) ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3114/ | grep -E 'class="title"'
echo "=== notes survived ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3114/books/fffee0d2-8af1-448d-8ce0-6a2d182cb166 | grep -o 'Reread the labyrinth chapters.'
echo "=== 404 for a bad id ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3114/books/bogus
echo "=== files left in the data dir ==="
ls /tmp/smoke/ | grep -v log
kill $SRV; echo "server stopped"
